❌ Legacy Non-Compliant RTP Keepalive Failure Modes (RFC 6263)

discarded empty/unknown-PT packets triggers false Opus PLC & fake loss.
2. Static-Seq SRTP Replay Drop: Sending RTP keepalives without advancing
Seq triggers SRTP anti-replay rejection and ROC rollover desynchronization.
3. Hold / Tool-Wait NAT Pinhole Expiry: Silence >30s during slow ERP tool
execution or a=sendonly hold drops firewall UDP mappings (one-way audio).
Result: False PLC audio glitches + post-hold one-way audio dead air
